final: SELECT s1.gender, s1.cnt, s1.cnt - s2.avg_cnt AS diff FROM (SELECT c.gender AS gender, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Orders o JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.date_order_placed >= '2013-10-25 17:40:25' AND o.date_order_placed <= '2017-05-24 19:26:44' GROUP BY c.gender) s1 JOIN (SELECT AVG(cnt) AS avg_cnt FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM Orders o JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE o.date_order_placed >= '2013-10-25 17:40:25' AND o.date_order_placed <= '2017-05-24 19:26:44' GROUP BY c.gender)) s2 WHERE s1.cnt > s2.avg_cnt AND s2.avg_cnt IS NOT NULL
